---
title: "Plant Genetics (PLS 152) — Fall 2026"
---

**Instructor:** Grey Monroe (gmonroe@ucdavis.edu) · **TA:** Alice Pierce

**Meetings:** Tuesdays & Thursdays, 3:10–5:00 PM, Veihmeyer Hall 212 — one
continuous block with a short break (the registrar's separate 20-min
"discussion" listing is an artifact; plan for the full 3:10–5:00).

**CRN:** 42467 · 4 units · Prerequisite: BIS 2A

How the course runs: a short **reflection** after each class (due 11:59 PM
same day), **low-stakes quizzes** due Tuesdays at 3:10 PM covering the
previous week, a **midterm paper** ([mini literature review](midterm.qmd)),
and a **final group presentation** ([capstone](capstone.qmd)). Quizzes and
submissions happen on Canvas;
all course materials live here.
